question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Mythical
solution:
The correct answer is: **Verifiable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mythical"** refers to something that is imaginary, not real, or existing only in myths or legends. (काल्पनिक/पौराणिक)
 
 
• **Example: **The phoenix is a mythical bird that is said to rise from its ashes.
 
 
 
• **"Verifiable"** means something that can be proven to be true or accurate through evidence or facts. (सत्यापनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The scientist’s claims are verifiable through experiments and data.
 
 
 
• Since "Mythical" refers to something that is not real or cannot be proven, its antonym would be "Verifiable," which refers to something that can be proven or verified.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Verifiable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Imaginary** (काल्पनिक): Refers to something that exists only in the mind and not in reality.
 
 
• **Example: **She has an imaginary friend that she talks to every day.
 
 
 
• **Supernatural** (अलौकिक): Refers to something that is beyond the laws of nature or attributed to a divine or otherworldly power.
 
 
• **Example: **The story revolves around supernatural beings like ghosts and spirits.
 
 
 
• **Symbolic** (प्रतीकात्मक): Refers to something that represents or stands for another thing, especially an idea or concept.
 
 
• **Example: **The dove is symbolic of peace and harmony.
